title: This AI Learns From Its Own Mistakes 🤯 #shorts  #ai #chatgpt #aitutorial #coding #technology
description:
🚀 What if AI could learn from its own mistakes just like humans?

In this video, I explain SkillOpt, an innovative AI training framework that helps language models improve through reflection, validation, and continuous skill updates. Instead of relying only on traditional training, SkillOpt introduces an iterative learning loop that makes AI smarter over time.

In this video:
✅ SkillOpt explained
✅ AI training loop
✅ Reflection-based AI learning
✅ How LLMs improve
✅ Future of AI models
✅ Latest AI research

Whether you're an AI enthusiast, developer, researcher, or student, this is one of the most exciting advances in AI training.
